title: JSMC
description:
Give a refresh for vanilla minecraft!
This modpack do: better performance, better visual, better sound and some quality-of-life features
body:
#
A modpack to enhance vanilla Minecraft.

This pack includes:









P.S. This is basic mods, texturepacks and shaders that I'm using in my every personal modpack, so I finally decided to collect them all in one place. Hope it will be useful for someone. Enjoy.
